version_review.evidence: CfC original PDF labels Local authorities in PUA, corroborated by workbook summary and CSV; reviewed code/name table below and ONS correspondence evidence. Entire supplied May-2025 LAD members are used.

limitations: LAD BGC is generalised at 20 m and clipped to Mean High Water.
PUA union of whole LADs is not a fine built-up-area outline; Bournemouth includes the whole Dorset LAD per source.
Current boundaries are used, not a reconstruction of 2022 boundaries.
Station coordinates use the fixed approximate offline seven-parameter operation; no boundary buffer/tolerance.
Geography eligibility is not entity cleaning, query eligibility or coverage completeness.
